newsAlerts.headline: LinkedIn rebuilt its feed algorithm using LLMs — AI-generated content being actively penalized
newsAlerts.summary: LinkedIn has replaced its ranking system with LLM-based Generative Recommender models. Generic/template AI content is now detected and downranked. Company page organic reach has fallen 60-66% YoY; personal profiles down ~50%. Algorithm now rewards authentic expert-level content and 1:1 outreach. Former LinkedIn insider confirmed 'everything shifted in Feb 2026.'
newsAlerts.relevance: HIGH — directly impacts our LinkedIn DM outreach strategy (25 DMs/day). Actionable: avoid AI-sounding copy in DMs, lean into hyper-personalized 1:1 messages. Personal profile > company page for reach.

newsAlerts.headline: GPT-5.4 (full) released — 1M context window, native computer use, Tool Search cuts token cost 50%
newsAlerts.summary: OpenAI shipped GPT-5.4 with a 1M-token context window, native computer use, and a Tool Search feature that halves token costs on tool-heavy workflows. Positioned directly against Claude Code. Could significantly reduce API costs for Agent-as-a-Service deployments with large context needs.
newsAlerts.relevance: HIGH — 50% token cost reduction on tool-heavy calls lowers our COGS; monitor for API pricing update. 1M context opens new agent capabilities (e.g., ingesting full CRM exports for lead bots).

newsAlerts.headline: NYT covers AI agents going mainstream — 'personal digital assistants that use software on your behalf'
newsAlerts.summary: New York Times ran a feature (March 19) on AI agents doing real-world tasks for everyday people. Signals that non-technical buyers (our ICP: realtors, HVAC owners) are now reading mainstream AI agent coverage — increasing market readiness and reducing cold-pitch education burden.
newsAlerts.relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH — timing advantage: our targets are now pre-primed. Lead with 'you may have seen in the news' framing in outreach to reduce friction.

newsAlerts.headline: Gumroad mass creator exodus — 10% flat fee killing platform's marketplace value
newsAlerts.summary: Multiple creator economy outlets (ThriveCart, DodoPayments, SchoolMaker) flagged this week that Gumroad's shift to a flat 10% transaction fee + removal of tiered pricing has triggered a mass migration of established creators to alternatives. Discover marketplace traffic weakening as seller count drops. In 2026, Gumroad's lack of storefront customization is also being cited as a brand liability.
newsAlerts.relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH — Websage has a Cold Email Vault product planned for Gumroad (currently paused). If the Discover marketplace degrades, organic discovery value drops. Consider Lemon Squeezy or Whop as alternatives when ready to launch digital products. Also a content angle: 'Where to sell AI prompts in 2026' could attract inbound.
